title: #279 Remote Learning
prompt: In the future, students may have the choice of studying at home by using technology such as computers or television instead of studying at traditional schools. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages thereof.

requirements.en: Discuss the important advantages and disadvantages.
requirements.vi: Thảo luận những ưu điểm và nhược điểm quan trọng.

requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ phần so sánh bằng ví dụ phù hợp.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of remote learning is the time and schedule freedom it gives to students.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of remote learning is the need for focus and the importance of physical school time.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Remote learning offers more time for students.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Students miss face-to-face time with friends and teachers.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The main advantage of remote learning is the flexibility it gives students to manage their time and balance other life commitments.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main advantage of remote learning is the flexibility it gives students to manage their time and balance other life commitments.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The main disadvantage of remote learning is the potential for social isolation and missing out on face-to-face social development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The main disadvantage of remote learning is the potential for social isolation and missing out on face-to-face social development.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Remote learning provides great flexibility, allowing students to study from various locations and balance their work and education.

angles.label: Point 2
